article_title: Eiffel Tower shut by staff strike over female workers being moved for religious visit

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A staff strike after female Eiffel Tower workers were moved during a religious group's visit
A plan to replace the Eiffel Tower with a Hindu temple
A tourist strike against higher ticket prices in Paris
A new rule banning all religious groups from French monuments
tasks.correct_answer: A staff strike after female Eiffel Tower workers were moved during a religious group's visit
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בשביתה בעקבות הרחקת עובדות ממקומות עבודתן בזמן ביקור משלחת דתית.

tasks.prompt: What did union representative Diane Davoine say happened when the delegation arrived?
options: All employees were sent home because the tower was unsafe
Women were asked to leave their work positions so men could take their places
The delegation refused to enter the monument
Only managers were allowed to speak to visitors
tasks.correct_answer: Women were asked to leave their work positions so men could take their places
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לדברי נציגת האיגוד, נשים התבקשו לעזוב את עמדות העבודה שלהן כדי שגברים יתפסו את מקומן.

tasks.prompt: How did SETE describe the conditions requested for the delegation's visit?
options: They were legally required by the city
They were normal for every large tour
They should not have been accepted and conflicted with the company's values
They were designed only to reduce ticket queues
tasks.correct_answer: They should not have been accepted and conflicted with the company's values
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברה המפעילה אמרה שהתנאים לא היו צריכים להתקבל ושאינם תואמים את ערכיה ואת עקרון השוויון.

tasks.prompt: In the sentence “Tensions mounted over the weekend,” what does “mounted” mean?
options: Were completely forgotten
Were formally investigated
Moved to another building
Increased or grew stronger
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה mounted פירושו שהמתח גבר והתחזק במהלך סוף השבוע.

tasks.prompt: Why did employees want to open a dialogue with management?
options: To prevent women from being treated this way again
To arrange another private visit for the group
To close the monument permanently
To ask visitors to work at the tower
tasks.correct_answer: To prevent women from being treated this way again
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העובדים רצו שיח עם ההנהלה כדי לוודא שמקרה דומה של יחס מפלה לנשים לא יחזור.

tasks.prompt: What does “legitimate” mean in the mayor's statement that employees' discontent was legitimate?
options: Secret and impossible to explain
Reasonable and justified
Temporary and unimportant
Organised by foreign visitors
tasks.explanation_hebrew: legitimate בהקשר זה פירושו מוצדק וסביר; ראש העיר הכיר בכך שלעובדים יש סיבה אמיתית לכעוס.

tasks.prompt: Describe the delegation's visit and the responses from SETE and BAPS.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין מי ביקר, מה התבקש, וכיצד הן החברה המפעילה והן BAPS הגיבו לאחר האירוע.
expected_points: Around 100 people linked to BAPS visited the Eiffel Tower on Saturday
The delegation asked for the visit to limit interactions with women
Female workers were moved from their positions
SETE said the conditions should not have been accepted
SETE said the conditions conflicted with equality and company values
Management apologised to workers
BAPS said the visit was arranged with the Eiffel Tower team
BAPS apologised for pain or inconvenience and referred to mutual respect

tasks.prompt: Why did this incident become a wider public and political issue in France?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין האירוע לבין שוויון מגדרי, ערכים ציבוריים והתגובות של נבחרי הציבור.
expected_points: The incident happened at a major national landmark
Women were moved because of a visitor group's request
Workers viewed the treatment as humiliating
SETE said it conflicted with equality between women and men
Paris Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire said equality must apply everywhere
Politicians from different parties rejected limiting women's presence
The mayor announced an investigation into the circumstances

tasks.prompt: Summarise the event that closed the Eiffel Tower and the main responses to it.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את האירוע, השביתה, עמדת העובדים, תגובת המפעילה, תגובת BAPS והחקירה המתוכננת.
expected_points: A BAPS-linked delegation visited the Eiffel Tower
Women were asked to leave work positions to limit interaction with the group
Employees said the women felt humiliated
Staff went on strike and the tower closed on Monday
Workers sought dialogue and guarantees against a repeat
SETE apologised and rejected the conditions as inconsistent with equality
BAPS said the visit was coordinated and apologised for pain or inconvenience
Paris's mayor announced an investigation

tasks.prompt: Write a short workplace policy response that SETE could issue after the incident.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית תגובה עניינית הכוללת התנצלות, עקרון שוויון, צעדים מעשיים ובדיקה של האירוע, ללא המצאת עובדות.
expected_points: Acknowledge what happened to the female workers
Offer a clear apology
State that visitor requests cannot override gender equality
Commit to keeping women in their normal work roles
Describe staff guidance or approval procedures for future group visits
Mention dialogue with employees or unions
Support an investigation or review
Use respectful, professional language
